Class BankAccountTriggerHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class BankAccountTriggerHandlerTest

Tests for BankAccountTriggerHandler and BankAccountTriggerHelper, covering the standard trigger contexts (afterInsert, afterUpdate, beforeUpdate, beforeDelete) and the Link junction behaviors (cascade delete, runAfterLogic guard, validation rules).

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    08/30/2021

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 08/30/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 05/22/2022 - v1.1 - Use trigger framework new methods.
  • 05/08/2026 - v1.2 - Add tests for Link record type: cascade delete, runAfterLogic guard, validation rules.
  • 05/09/2026 - v1.3 - Add test for beforeInsert copying parent Name onto Link records.

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
accountLinkRequiresParentBankAccountTest()
Verifies that the validation rule Link_Requires_Parent_And_Account blocks insertion of an Link record without a Parent Bank Account.
private static void
afterInsertSetsLatestAsDefaultTest()
Verifies that inserting a Mercury bank account flagged as default unsets the prior default record on the same record type.
private static void
afterUpdateSetsAsDefaultTest()
Verifies that updating a Mercury bank account to default unsets the prior default record on the same record type.
private static void
beforeInsertCopiesParentNameToLinkTest()
Verifies that inserting a Link record copies its parent bank account's Name onto the new junction row, regardless of any Name value supplied by the caller.
private static void
beforeUpdateFlagsPendingUpdateOnFieldChangeTest()
Verifies that modifying a tracked field on an active ACH bank account sets PendingBankUpdate__c=true and populates Message__c with the pending-update message.
private static void
beforeUpdateRespectsIgnoreChangesTest()
Verifies that setting IgnoreChanges__c=true while modifying a tracked field bypasses the pending-update flagging logic and resets the ignore flag back to false.
private static void
cascadeDeleteAccountLinksTest()
Verifies that deleting a real BankAccount__c cascades the deletion to its Link junction children.
private static void
onlyAccountLinkCanHaveParentTest()
Verifies that the validation rule Only_Link_Can_Have_Parent blocks setting ParentBankAccount__c on a non-Link record.
private static void
runAfterLogicSkipsAccountLinkTest()
Verifies that runAfterLogic skips Link records and does not invoke BankAccountService.makeDefault for them.
